title: ambient_temp records (<data-dir>/history/ambient_temp.jsonl)
description: One record per complete past UTC hour: the 2 m air temperature of that hour at the county-level location, fetched by tools/ambient_temp.py from a weather service (Open-Meteo). Append-only, size-capped (2 MB x 2 generations), at most one record per hour. PRIVACY: a record never carries a location (not the configured coordinates, not the 0.1 degree rounded ones); the schema rejects the obvious keys. Optional covariates (1.1.0): wind_ms, precip_mm, cloud_pct; a record without them (1.0.0) stays valid. Readers MUST ignore unknown fields and tolerate absent optional ones, and skip a record whose `v` they do not know.

t_hour_utc.description: Unix seconds of the START of the UTC hour the value belongs to (the value is the Open-Meteo hourly value stamped with that hour).

temp_c.description: 2 m air temperature in degrees Celsius. Never NaN or null: such hours are not written.

model_grid_km.description: Grid spacing of the weather model in km when known; null when not known (the producer writes null: Open-Meteo does not report the grid of its blended default).

wind_ms.description: Optional (1.1.0). 10 m wind speed in m/s of that hour. Absent when the service had no valid value (null, NaN, out of range).

precip_mm.description: Optional (1.1.0). Precipitation in mm: the Open-Meteo `precipitation` value stamped with t_hour_utc, stored as given. Absent when invalid.

cloud_pct.description: Optional (1.1.0). Total cloud cover in percent of that hour. Absent when invalid.
